thread:
maria_pm: Quick thought — what if saved queries in Console showed a "routing preview" badge that surfaces friendly routing hints + a 'simulate' button? Helps PMs pick model defaults without digging into infra.

devin_platform: Sounds useful. Implementation-wise we'll need savedQuery -> router_preview metadata. Keep it lightweight: tier label, rough token estimate, sample_pct, sla_flag, stability_score.

ash_design: UX idea: compact chip row under the query name: icons for SLA + stability (colored dot) + est cost. Clicking 'simulate' opens a small modal with recent hit-rate and an example latency/cost estimate.

raj_sre: Two concerns: (1) leaking real model names or exact fallback sequences, and (2) heavy backend calls if users spam simulate. Recommend showing abstract tiers (e.g., "premium|balanced|economy") and rate-limit simulate to N/day per org.

juna_devex: For simulate I'd prefer an async preview endpoint that returns a summarized decision path (no internal IDs) plus aggregated cost/latency percentiles. Also an option to run against a sandbox payload that doesn't affect quotas.

maria_pm: Agree with Raj on obfuscation. We should avoid exposing model IDs by default. Make detailed routing logs available only to admin roles + in audit logs.

ops-bot: telemetry: routing_preview.viewed { saved_query: SQ-9001 }

devin_platform: Draft API contract sketch I'll propose: saved_query has fields: routing_preview_label (string), est_token_burn (string), sample_pct (string), sla (string), stability (string), simulate_endpoint (url OR null). Keeping them flat strings avoids heavy payloads.

ash_design: I'll mock three states: "no hint" (unknown), "friendly hint" (tier + badge), and "expanded preview" (mini chart + simulate CTA). Also will show a subtle warning if stability is low.

raj_sre: Security checklist: run the UI copy through legal for capacity disclosure, add a denylist for orgs with special compliance, and ensure simulate requests are audited.

juna_devex: Telemetry events to add: routing_preview.open, routing_preview.simulate.request, routing_preview.simulate.complete, routing_preview.settings.changed. We should also log whether simulate used sandbox mode.

maria_pm: Nice. Rollout plan: feature-flag in console to toggle full detail vs friendly-only, can A/B test icons vs textual hints. Small teams pilot first.

devin_platform: Implementation notes: backend will call routing engine with a small sample and return an opaque 'preview_token' mapping to human-friendly labels; simulate will accept either payload or sample_token and return estimated p50/p95 latencies + estimated token cost. We'll add rate limits and a short TTL for preview_token.

ash_design: Proposed copy for the pill tooltip: "Routing hint: friendly tier, stability score indicates how often this routing path changes. Click simulate to preview estimated latency & cost."

ops-bot: deploy-bot: routing-preview-service v0.2 deployed to staging

raj_sre: Also: don't show estimate numbers for orgs with less than X traffic to avoid noise. Use a confidence flag instead (low/medium/high).

juna_devex: I'll draft telemetry schemas and event examples. Recommend including saved_query_id, org_id (hashed), preview_mode, and simulate_duration_ms.

maria_pm: Action items: Ash -> mocks by Wed; Devin -> API PR + throttling plan by Fri; Raj -> security/legal signoff plus denylist; Juna -> telemetry schema & experiment flags. We'll reconvene after staging deploy looks good. Thanks! :tada:

devin_platform: Opening the PR now for the stub endpoint and basic contract.

ops-bot: telemetry: routing_preview.simulate.request { saved_query: SQ-9001, mode: "sandbox" }

maria_pm: Great progress — keep it lightweight for the first iteration.
